features.title: Smart / Guided Booking (two modes)
features.what: A guided client booking page with two modes — **Quick Book** (a recommended slot with a match score) and **Choose Your Own Time** (custom filters: service, artist, date, time, location).
features.why: Removes the "DM us to book" back-and-forth; a guided path instead of a bare form.

notes.text: UI is live but **availability and booking confirmation are currently client-side simulated (mock slots / mock booking IDs)**; the `getSmartAvailability` callable is commented out / not in the repo. **Do not claim "real-time online booking"** until the backend ships.

features.title: Service catalog / service picker
features.what: Admin-defined service types, each with duration, price (in cents), optional hourly rate, color, default and active flags; clients pick from pill-style buttons.
features.why: Drives correct durations/prices through the whole flow; hourly-rate support fits custom tattoo work.

features.title: Real-time conflict detection / double-booking prevention
features.what: `checkTimeSlotAvailability` checks workstation conflicts, member time-off, and working hours before a slot is accepted.
features.why: Nothing double-books a person or a chair; wrong-room / wrong-artist collisions are caught, not discovered at 2pm.

features.title: Staff booking on behalf of clients
features.what: Full appointment form for staff, including ad-hoc "add client" inline so a new client can be booked in one pass.
features.why: Fast phone/counter booking without forcing a full client signup.

features.title: Appointment management (CRUD)
features.what: Create / view / edit appointments from the calendar; each carries a client note and a team note.
features.why: One place to manage the whole day's book.

features.title: Appointment status workflow
features.what: Lifecycle states `booked / completed / cancelled / no_show / pending_reschedule / time_off`, with transitions and related alerts.
features.why: Feeds accurate stats (no-shows, completed), finance, and reminders.

features.title: Multi-view team calendar
features.what: **Day** (per-workstation time grid), **Week** (agenda), **Month** (overview).
features.why: The core surface; multiple views fit different planning horizons.

features.title: "My schedule only" filter
features.what: Team members filter the calendar to just their own appointments.
features.why: No more scrolling through six people's bookings to find yours.

features.title: Appointment detail modal (linked context)
features.what: A detail view linking the client's contact info, assigned artist, workstation, notes, reference images, and who created the booking.
features.why: Full context in one click before the client walks in.

features.title: Reference / booking images per appointment
features.what: Client or team uploads reference images (design refs, before/after); auto-resized on upload, deletable; surfaced in the artist's upcoming schedule and the team-member profile; a notification to the assigned team member is designed.
features.why: A creative-studio workflow — the artist sees exactly what to draw before the appointment. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Client self-reschedule via secure one-time link
features.what: A tokenized, expiring link (48h, admin-configurable) that lets a client pick an alternative slot computed from the artist's real working hours + time-off + reschedule slots.
features.why: Cuts "can I move my appointment?" messages without giving clients a full login.

notes.text: Backend functions exist, but feature doc 008 marks this **"in progress / blocked"** (documented bugs in `initiateReschedule` — date-range / working-hours), while `PROJECT_PROGRESS` lists it **DONE**. Treated as 🟡 pending verification.

features.title: Reschedule policy controls + per-artist slot windows
features.what: Admin policy knobs — `searchStartDaysBefore`, `maxSearchDays`, `maxSlotsPerSearch`, `tokenExpirationHours` — plus per-member reschedule slot windows.
features.why: Studios control how far out / how many slots a client may search; artists can carve out their own reschedulable windows.

features.title: Per-artist & business-wide working hours
features.what: Working-hours definitions at both the business level and per artist.
features.why: Drives availability, conflict checks, and reschedule slot search.

features.title: Time-off scheduling (with reason) + staff status bar
features.what: Artists book time off with a reason; a status bar surfaces it across the team.
features.why: Prevents booking into a known absence; the team can see who's out.

features.title: Buffer time (per artist + per workstation)
features.what: `bufferMinutes` on both team members and workstations.
features.why: Built-in clean-up/setup time so appointments don't butt against each other.

features.title: Workstation / chair as a bookable resource
features.what: Appointments are tied to a location + a specific workstation; workstations have **capacity** and **buffer**, and conflict detection runs **per workstation** (day view renders a per-chair time grid).
features.why: Most booking tools book *people*; this books the **physical chair too**, so two artists can't be double-booked into the same station. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Multi-location scheduling
features.what: Appointments carry a `locationId`; each location has its own timezone and currency.
features.for: Owners running more than one site
features.why: Correct time and currency across regions from one app.

features.title: Client profiles / database
features.what: A client record with name, email, phone, and **Instagram handle**, plus contact info and booking history.
features.why: Everything about a client lives in one place, not scattered across notes apps and group chats. The Instagram field is a social-first touch for creative studios. *(Niche.)*

features.title: Live client stats
features.what: Auto-maintained counters — total visits, completed, cancelled, no-shows — updated by the `updateClientStats` Cloud Function.
features.why: Real retention / no-show signal without manual tracking.

features.title: Client search
features.what: Search clients by name, email, or phone.
features.why: Fast lookup at the desk or before an appointment.

features.title: Booking enable / disable per client (`canBook`)
features.what: An admin-gated activation flag that controls whether a client may self-book.
features.why: Studios control who can book online (e.g., only after a phone screening or a first-visit deposit).

features.title: Add / edit / delete clients from admin
features.what: Full client CRUD in the admin area, plus "add client" inline in the booking form.
features.why: Keep the client database clean and current.

features.title: Client self-signup (email/password + magic link)
features.what: Clients can create an account (email/password or passwordless magic link); new accounts start **pending activation** until an admin enables `canBook`.
features.why: Self-service onboarding, still gated by the studio.

notes.text: post multi-tenant deploy, the onboarding flow changes with the client-onboarding wave (see §49).

features.title: Composite client profile (multi-tenant)
features.what: Client documents keyed as `clients/{businessId}_{authUid}`, so one person can be a client across multiple studios.
features.for: Clients who visit more than one studio; Owners
features.why: A single account spanning studios without data leaking between them. Part of the multi-tenant wave (deploy pending).

features.title: Versioned privacy consent + re-consent
features.what: Consent is versioned; when the privacy policy updates, clients are prompted to re-consent.
features.why: GDPR-style consent trail with auditability.

features.title: Self-service data export (JSON download)
features.what: A client can download all of their data as JSON (right to data portability).
features.why: A GDPR data-right, self-served.

notes.text: UI exists; the `requestDataExport` callable is **not found** in the current repo. Confirm before claiming.

features.title: Self-service account / data deletion (with reason)
features.what: A client can request deletion of their account / data, providing a reason.
features.why: The "right to be forgotten," self-served and logged.

notes.text: UI exists; the `requestDataDeletion` callable is **not found** in the current repo. Confirm before claiming.

features.title: Multi-artist team calendar with per-artist color coding
features.what: A shared team calendar where each artist is color-coded and their schedule is distinct.
features.why: Admins see everyone; the visual separation makes a busy shop readable.

features.title: Three-tier roles + custom role definitions
features.what: Owner / Admin / Member (Artist) tiers, plus the ability to define custom roles.
features.why: Granular, studio-specific permission shapes rather than only three fixed buckets.

features.title: Role-based UI access
features.what: UI gates by role — admin dashboard, finance gated by a `financeEnabled` flag, client-only navigation, and role-aware header nav.
features.why: A new hire doesn't see the whole shop's financials on day one; nobody is locked out of what they need.

features.title: Client → staff promotion flow
features.what: An atomic, auth-account-aware flow that turns a client into a team member.
features.why: Hire an existing client without manual account surgery.

notes.text: The **new P6 implementation is deploy pending** (multi-tenant wave); the **old flow is live** in the meantime.

features.title: Team member management (complete setup)
features.what: Full team-member administration, including working hours, colors, reschedule slots, and promotion.
features.why: One place to run the team.

features.title: Per-team-member stats
features.what: Stats per team member, maintained by the `updateTeamMemberStats` Cloud Function.
features.why: Performance / activity view per artist.

features.title: Finance module (complete)
features.what: A full finance area: ledgers, sync, checkout, commission, month-close, recurring entries, and printing.
features.why: Studio money is tracked inside the scheduler instead of on a napkin.

features.title: Per-artist commission / split-pay ledger
features.what: Per-transaction artist-vs-shop split, tracked on each ledger entry.
features.why: The "who owes what" answer is automatic, per transaction. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Ledger checkout / finalize
features.what: A checkout-and-finalize step for ledger entries; finalized entries lock in place.
features.why: No "wait, did we already pay that out?" — confirmed entries can't be double-counted.

features.title: Month-close + carry-forward + locked months
features.what: Close a month, carry forward balances, and lock closed months from further edits.
features.why: Clean period boundaries with immutability for accounting.

features.title: Recurring events / recurring ledger entries
features.what: Support for recurring (repeating) appointments / ledger items.
features.why: Regulars and retainer work without re-entry.

features.title: "Paid upfront" €0.00 rule (commission integrity)
features.what: A rule that treats fully-paid-upfront jobs so the commission split stays consistent (e.g., a €0.00 residual with the full amount attributed correctly).
features.why: Prevents commission math from breaking on prepaid jobs. *(Niche.)*

features.title: Finance print report (bilingual EN/DE)
features.what: A printable finance report; labels are provided in **English and German**.
features.why: A real document to hand to an accountant or keep on file; the EN/DE labels hint at a growing EU audience.

features.title: Perspective-aware finance display
features.what: The same ledger can be viewed from the artist's perspective or the shop's perspective.
features.why: Each role sees the split from the side that matters to them.

features.title: Stripe payment integration (deposits / full payment at booking)
features.what: Take deposits or full payments at booking time via Stripe.
features.why: Reduce no-shows and capture revenue in-flow. *(Planned / roadmap.)*

features.title: Multi-location (full)
features.what: Locations with full admin CRUD, each carrying a **timezone**, a **currency**, and a default setting.
features.why: Run several sites from one app with correct time/currency per site.

features.title: Multi-tenant architecture (strict isolation)
features.what: Businesses/tenants with slugs + memberships; one user account can belong to multiple studios; Firestore rules enforce strict per-tenant isolation.
features.why: "One account, many studios" without any cross-studio data leakage.

notes.text: Implemented + tested; **deployment pending** as of 2026-08-29. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Tenant selection / switching UI
features.what: A `/select-tenant` route, a `TenantContextSwitcher`, and an `/access-denied` screen.
features.why: Switch the active studio in-app; clean fallback when a user lacks access to the requested tenant.

features.title: Business / tenant onboarding
features.what: `createBusinessOwnerMembership` Cloud Function performs 7-document atomic provisioning, including a composite owner client profile; an ops CLI script (`create_tenant.py`) also exists.
features.why: A studio can be stood up atomically and consistently.

notes.text: Part of the multi-tenant wave (deploy pending).

features.title: Business bootstrap script (`create_business.py`)
features.what: A proposed one-step business bootstrap script.
features.why: Faster, scriptable studio creation. *(Documented as "Proposed — not yet implemented".)*

features.title: Branded public booking URL (`/{slug}/booking`) + public studio discovery
features.what: Each studio gets its own public slug URL that clients hit directly, plus public discovery of studios.
features.why: "yourstudio.app/booking" instead of "DM us to book." *(Deferred — task 10.3; not yet built.)*

features.title: Client onboarding wave (composite client model)
features.what: Studio picker at signup, multi-studio switching for pure clients, and public studio discovery.
features.why: Until this ships, **pure-client self-booking is degraded** relative to the multi-tenant design.

features.title: Business branding fields (`primaryColor`, `secondaryColor`, `logoUrl`)
features.what: Branding fields on the Business document.
features.why: Studio theming / white-labeling.

notes.text: Fields exist but **no UI applies them yet**; today the only live branding touch is the **default location name shown as the app title** in the header. Tied to the "customizable themes" roadmap item.

features.title: Push notifications (booking created)
features.what: `sendNewAppointmentNotification` fires on a new booking (push + in-app + email queue).
features.why: Everyone knows a new appointment landed, immediately.

features.title: Push notifications (cancel / reschedule)
features.what: `sendAppointmentModifiedNotification` fires when an appointment is cancelled or rescheduled.
features.why: Cancellation / change is surfaced in real time, not discovered later.

features.title: Stats notifications
features.what: Team / client stats updates emit notifications via `updateClientStats` / `updateTeamMemberStats`.
features.why: Activity signal without opening the dashboard.

features.title: App-icon badge count
features.what: `syncBadgeCount` keeps the PWA icon's unread badge in sync.
features.why: At-a-glance "something needs attention" on the home screen.

features.title: In-app notification center
features.what: A centralized in-app inbox for all notifications.
features.why: History and retrieval of every event in one place.

features.title: Notification tiers for staff
features.what: Staff can set a tier / level of push noise.
features.why: Control how much the app pings you — a quality-of-life differentiator for busy chairs. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Automated 24h / 1h reminders (scheduled Cloud Function)
features.what: Scheduled reminders sent 24h and 1h before an appointment.
features.why: The single biggest no-show reducer.

notes.text: `PROJECT_PROGRESS` lists this as **WORKING**, but **no scheduled-reminder function was found in the current repo** and the design spec lists reminders as future work. **Confirm before claiming.**

features.title: Client-facing notifications
features.what: Notification delivery to clients (beyond current triggers).
features.why: Close the loop on the client side. *(Planned.)*

features.title: Admin form builder
features.what: A `FormBuilder` for creating studio forms, plus `ClientForm` rendering; storage and Firestore rules exist.
features.why: Define any form (intake, consent) without hard-coding.

notes.text: Currently a single-form setup ("in a real app you'd have a list of forms"); a multi-form manager is on the roadmap.

features.title: Client-facing intake / consent forms
features.what: Clients complete intake/consent forms (medical/health context for tattooing) before or at the appointment.
features.why: Paperwork done before the chair, not during it.

notes.text: Builder + storage + rules are in place; the **client-facing wired flow is the next roadmap step** ("NEXT").

features.title: Email delivery infra (mail queue)
features.what: A mail queue exists to stage outgoing email.
features.why: Asynchronous, reliable email.

notes.text: Actual **delivery is handled externally** — the repo stores/queues; sending is a separate concern.

features.title: Forms authorization model / email tenant scoping
features.what: Scoping forms and email to tenants + an authorization model for forms.
features.why: Keep forms/email correct in a multi-tenant world. *(Roadmap.)*

features.title: In-app post-visit reviews
features.what: Clients leave a review straight from the app after an appointment; the UI is complete and Firestore rules allow client creation of reviews.
features.why: No chasing people down for a Google review.

features.title: Review stats / triggers
features.what: Stats around reviews are maintained by live Cloud Functions.
features.why: Reputation signal aggregated, not manual.

features.what: After a review, the client is offered a 10%-off code for their next visit (currently **hardcoded in the UI**).

features.title: Social engagement funnel (Instagram follow + Google review)
features.what: The review flow can route to an Instagram follow and a Google review, with engagement tracking.
features.why: One action grows both the studio's socials and its Google rating.

features.title: Client waitlist UI (join / leave) + rules
features.what: Clients can join/leave a waitlist; the UI and Firestore rules exist.
features.why: When the slot they want is gone, they land in a waitlist tied to that request — not a text you'll forget to follow up on.

notes.text: The `joinWaitlist` callable is **not found** in the current repo. Confirm before claiming.

features.title: Waitlist tied to artist + time + workstation (with status lifecycle)
features.what: Waitlist entries are keyed to a **specific artist, time, and workstation**, with a status lifecycle.
features.why: A waitlist that knows *which chair / which artist* frees up — a plus over generic "I'm interested" lists.

notes.text: A staff-list rule exists, but **no dedicated staff UI was found** yet; treat as partially surfaced. *(Differentiator.)*

features.title: Performance dashboard (metrics + alerts)
features.what: An admin performance dashboard with key metrics and alerts.
features.why: A single pane for how the studio is doing.

features.title: Admin appointment list (search, edit, delete)
features.what: A searchable admin list of all appointments with edit/delete.
features.why: Bulk oversight and correction outside the calendar.

features.title: Admin settings suite
features.what: One area to manage locations, workstations, service types, roles, working hours, forms, reschedule policy, and ledgers.
features.why: The studio's configuration is all in one place.

features.title: Admin CRUD: business hours, roles, services, workstations, locations
features.what: Full create/read/update/delete for the core reference data.
features.why: Studio can model itself accurately (hours, staff, services, chairs, sites).

features.title: Debug tools (admin-only diagnostics)
features.what: An admin-only debug/diagnostics tab.
features.why: Faster triage.

notes.text: Internal tooling — **excluded from marketing / copywriting.**

features.title: Installable PWA
features.what: A full PWA — `manifest.json`, service worker, install prompt, and iOS install instructions.
features.why: Installs to the home screen like a native app.

features.title: Offline mode + connection indicator + real-time sync
features.what: Service-worker caching, an offline indicator (shows offline / cache state), and IndexedDB persistence; data syncs on reconnect.
features.for: Artists (bad signal in the chair), Everyone

features.title: Real-time everything
features.what: Calendar, waitlist, ledger, and notifications update live via Firestore `onSnapshot` listeners.
features.why: No refresh; the whole team sees changes as they happen.

features.title: Passwordless magic-link sign-in
features.what: Email magic-link login in addition to email/password.
features.why: Lower-friction, secure sign-in.

features.title: Role-aware navigation + pending-activation home state
features.what: The shell adapts to the user's role and their activation state (booking-enabled / pending / staff).
features.why: Each person lands on the screen that's actually theirs.

features.title: Mobile-first finance UI
features.what: The finance area is designed mobile-first.
features.why: Check the books from a phone at the end of the day.

features.title: Multi-language support
features.what: i18n across the app.
features.why: Reach a broader market.

notes.text: **Partial today** — finance print is already EN/DE, and a `useRescheduleTranslation` hook exists on the reschedule page; full i18n is roadmap.

features.title: Customizable themes / branding application
features.what: Apply business branding (colors, logo) across the app.
features.why: White-label / studio-branded experience. *(Tied to #50; roadmap.)*

differentiators.title: Studio commission accounting built into the scheduler
differentiators.line: Per-transaction artist-vs-shop split with checkout, finalize, month-close, carry-forward, locked months, and a "paid upfront" integrity rule. No mainstream booking tool does studio revenue accounting. This is the "napkin math" killer — the single pain line that lands hardest with real shop owners.

differentiators.title: Chairs / workstations as bookable resources with conflict detection
differentiators.line: Most tools book *people*; this books the physical station (capacity + buffer), preventing two artists from landing in the same chair.

differentiators.title: Design-reference workflow per appointment
differentiators.line: Reference / before-after images attached to the appointment, so the artist sees exactly what to draw before the client walks in. A genuine creative-industry workflow.

differentiators.title: Secure one-time client reschedule link with studio-configurable policy
differentiators.line: Tokenized, expiring, constrained to the artist's real windows; the admin dials the search window. Rare in booking tools.

differentiators.title: In-app post-visit review with a discount-code funnel + social proof loop
differentiators.line: Closes the loop the others stop at: review → 10%-off code → Instagram follow → Google review, all tracked.

differentiators.title: Per-artist waitlist tied to artist + time + workstation
differentiators.line: Not just "I'm interested," but a specific slot/chair request with a status lifecycle.

differentiators.title: Artist-first mobile PWA with notification tiers
differentiators.line: Staff get an installable app with controllable push noise and offline mode.

differentiators.title: True multi-tenant isolation
differentiators.line: One account across multiple studios, rule-enforced.

differentiators.title: Instagram handle on the client record
differentiators.line: A social-first client base for creative studios.

niche: Commission split / studio finance (artist vs shop cut)
Instagram handle on client profile + social funnel
Custom hourly rates for custom work
No-show tracking (high no-show cost in tattoo)
